summary: Pair-2 follow-on extensions (Waitlist Inbox + Restock Teaser) tested end-to-end on web + mobile plus the My Coupons post-refactor regression. All target flows PASS on BOTH surfaces. Web (/offers?tab=mine): waitlist-block renders above the coupons grid with 'Waiting on 1 restock', waitlist-item-cmp_fpk_spin + waitlist-leave-cmp_fpk_spin present; clicking Stop removes the row AND removes the whole waitlist-block since it was the only entry. QR modal (mycoupon-qr-modal / -img / -close) still opens/closes cleanly for an Active coupon. Mobile (/coupons -> coupons-tab-mine): identical parity — waitlist-block/item/leave testids, Stop removes the row; the outer-wrapper Modal QR pass still works end-to-end after the refactor. Restock teaser on /store/adv_fpk: sold-out cmp_fpk_spin card shows store-game-cmp_fpk_spin-restock '🔔 Fresh coupons drop at 12:00 AM'; non-sold-out cards (cmp_fpk_scratch/quiz/mystery) do NOT render a restock teaser on either surface — verified. Backend reused endpoints unchanged (GET /api/me/waitlist returns items with campaign_title, POST /api/store/adv_fpk/waitlist(/leave) idempotent). Waitlist was cleared during Stop tests and re-added via POST /api/store/adv_fpk/waitlist so demo@ is left on the waitlist again (final GET /api/me/waitlist -> cmp_fpk_spin). No new bugs found in these extensions. No regression detected in My Coupons refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: CouponOffers.jsx WaitlistBlock returns null when wl is null/empty — good UX (renders nothing before load). If GET /api/me/waitlist is slow this could briefly flash the coupons above the eventual block; consider a subtle skeleton if desired (non-blocking).

CouponOffers.jsx MyCouponsView passes header prop into every branch (loading/empty/error/grid) — verified in code, so the waitlist block appears even with zero coupons or an error state (spec-compliant).

mobile/app/coupons.tsx: Modal was moved to the OUTER wrapper so it's rendered regardless of body branch — good. The overlay's onPress={()=>setPass(null)} + inner View onStartShouldSetResponder pattern correctly prevents backdrop-tap-through when tapping the sheet.

StorePage.jsx: restockLabel uses toLocaleTimeString([]) so the label is server-timezone-agnostic on the client; sold-out gate is `soldOut && restockLabel` which correctly hides the teaser for non-sold-out cards. Same logic mirrored in mobile/app/store/[id].tsx. Good parity.
Pre-existing (iter132) mobile deprecation warnings still present in the app in general (shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents) — not touched by this diff; leaving as known hygiene.

success_rate.frontend: web 100% (waitlist + restock + QR regression); mobile 100% (waitlist + restock + QR regression)
